#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>
using namespace std;

const int M = 1000000007;
vector<bool> visited(1010101, false);
void dfs(unordered_set<long long>& visited, long long v, int k, int p)
{
    if (!visited.count(v))
    {
        visited.insert(v);
        dfs(visited, (v*k)%p, k, p);
    }
}

int main()
{
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    long long ans;
    ans = 1;
    if (k==1)
    {
        ans = p;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i)
    {
        if (!visited[i])
        {
            dfs(visited, i, k, p);
            ans = (ans*p)%M;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
